create.name: Robert MacPhee
create.bio:
Robert MacPhee is a facilitator, coach and author whose work is about getting clear on what matters most and then living by it. Fresh out of UC San Diego, he and a partner grew a summer job into a business with several hundred staff, and he later held senior roles in large companies before turning to training. He spent a period as director of training at the Canfield Training Group, working alongside Jack Canfield, and he helped found the Transformational Leadership Council, a network of personal-growth teachers that he went on to run as executive director.

His Values Based Life approach splits values into two kinds: priorities, the areas of life where you want real results, and ways of being, the qualities you want to bring to them. Keeping the two apart, he argues, makes values easier to name and to act on. He teaches the method through a self-paced video course, live groups on Zoom, retreats, one-to-one coaching and programmes for companies and schools, working from Sonoma, California, through his firms Heart Set and Excellent Decisions. He has written two books, Manifesting for Non-Gurus (2010), a five-step method for drawing in the results you want, and Living a Values Based Life (2023). At Esalen he leads an experiential weekend on finding and using your own values.

books.title: Manifesting for Non-Gurus: How to Quickly & Easily Attract Lasting Results
books.author: Robert MacPhee
books.description: A short, practical book published by his own company, Heartset, in 2010. It sets out a five-step process for getting clear on what you want and taking steady action towards it, and comes with a companion journal.

courses.title: The Values Based Path to a Life of Purpose and Meaning
courses.description: A weekend at Esalen in Big Sur built around his Values Based Life method. Through playful, hands-on exercises, participants name what matters most to them and the qualities they want to live by, then sketch a plan for bringing those into home, work and relationships.

courses.title: Living YOUR Values-Based Life Online Course
courses.description: A self-paced video course that walks through his method step by step. Modules move from what values are to choosing your top priorities and ways of being, then to checking how closely daily life matches them and making a plan.

courses.title: Robert MacPhee Coaching
courses.description: One-to-one coaching with Robert, aimed at clarifying values and vision and turning them into a concrete plan with ongoing support and accountability. Sessions are arranged directly with him.
